rules: At least 30 minutes between events for each athlete where possible; at least 10 hours between the two days if possible.

O2SN_2026.name: Olimpiade Olahraga Siswa Nasional (O2SN) 2026
O2SN_2026.organiser: Pusat Prestasi Nasional (Puspresnas), Sekretariat Jenderal, Kementerian Pendidikan Dasar dan Menengah
O2SN_2026.rules_basis: PASI rules adapted from World Athletics; the SD and SMA guides name WA edition 2026, the SMP guide edition 2025 (as printed)

SD.entries: 1 putra and 1 putri per contingent; each athlete takes part in both events
SD.events_ref: Pedoman O2SN SD/MI/Sederajat 2026, Lampiran A.1.c and A.2.a.6–7 (PDF p. 26)
SD.teams_note: A team has 2 athletes (PDF p. 27); the guide does not say whether a team is the contingent's putra and putri together.
SD.surface: synthetic track only, no earth or gravel (PDF p. 27)
SD.ranking: by time per event; place points from the number of teams down to 1 (38, 37, 36 … with 38 teams); highest total wins (PDF p. 27, 29)
SD.ties: equal totals for a position are a tie ("hasil sama", PDF p. 29)
SD.footwear: barefoot, shoes or spikes allowed (PDF p. 27)

KA_KANGA.description: Shuttle relay over hurdles out and flat sprint back; the first runner hands a relay ring to the second behind the flag; time from start until the second runner finishes
KA_KANGA.ref: Pedoman O2SN SD/MI/Sederajat 2026, Lampiran A.2.d.1 (PDF p. 27–28)
KA_KANGA.figure_note: The 11 m distances are read from the figure on PDF p. 28 (11 + 6 + 6 + 6 + 11 = 40 m); the text gives 40 m, 4 hurdles, 50 cm, 6 m apart.

KA_F1.description: Relay round a course of about 80 m with sprint, hurdles and slalom; each runner starts with a forward or sideways roll on a mat; 1–2 teams per start
KA_F1.ref: Pedoman O2SN SD/MI/Sederajat 2026, Lampiran A.2.d.2 (PDF p. 28–29)
KA_F1.note: Hurdle height is not stated for Formula 1.

SMP.entries: 1 putra and 1 putri per contingent; each athlete takes part in all three events
SMP.events_ref: Panduan O2SN SMP/MTs/Sederajat 2026, Lampiran A.1.c and A.2.a.6–7 (PDF p. 28)
SMP.trials_ref: Panduan O2SN SMP/MTs/Sederajat 2026, Lampiran A.2.d.2 (PDF p. 30)
SMP.implements_ref: Panduan O2SN SMP/MTs/Sederajat 2026, Lampiran A.2.c.3 (PDF p. 29)
SMP.timing: fully automatic timing/photo finish, backed up by digital hand stopwatches (PDF p. 29)
SMP.ranking: highest total of the three events' points (Trilomba table); equal totals are a tie (PDF p. 31–32)

qualifying.ref: Panduan O2SN SMP/MTs/Sederajat 2026, Lampiran A.2.a.10 (PDF p. 29, table image)

common: Eligibility (birth date, grades) is in atletik-kelompok-umur (O2SN_SD, O2SN_SMP, O2SN_SMA).

Not a past national champion of a PB PASI event (all levels) nor an international champion of a World Athletics event (SMP, SMA); details and other conditions in each guide's Bab III and Lampiran A.2.a.
Lanes and order by draw (WA rule cited as 'Pasal 141'); protests within 30 minutes of the official result; appeal in writing with a deposit of Rp1.000.000 within 30 minutes.
Roll call (SMP, SMA): track events first call 30 min and last call 20 min before the start, entry to the arena 15 min before; jumps and throws 60 / 40 / 30 min.
Medals for places 1–3 of the combined result (SD: Kids' Athletics total); certificates for places 1–3 per event and 4–8 overall.

entries: One athlete enters at most two individual events (Ketentuan 4).
Trilomba: at most 1 athlete per kabupaten/kota, who may not enter any other individual event (Ketentuan 5).
Quota per kabupaten/kota; at most 2 athletes of the same kabupaten/kota per event (Ketentuan 6).
An athlete takes part in one sport only (V.5).
POPDA_JATENG_2026.entries_ref: Juknis POPDA Tingkat Provinsi Jawa Tengah 2026 (Dispora Jateng, surat 400.3.9.2/371/2026, 27 Feb 2026), VII.2 Ketentuan 4–6 (PDF p. 5), V.5 (PDF p. 3)
POPDA_JATENG_2026.registration: SIMPORA, 1 July – 20 August 2026; offline verification 24 August 2026 (VIII, PDF p. 18)
POPDA_JATENG_2026.exhibition: An event with fewer than 5 kabupaten/kota taking part is an exhibition event: medals and certificates are given but do not count for the overall standing (IX, PDF p. 18).
POPDA_JATENG_2026.overall_standing: By medals (gold, silver, bronze); the winning kabupaten/kota receives a trophy (IX–X, PDF p. 18).

errata.reason: A 24 kg shot is impossible; the juknis does not show whether 3 kg (World Athletics U18) or 4 kg (U20, senior) is meant. Ask the organiser or the technical meeting minutes (F-031).
